raw_text: ALERT: Reports of fuel distribution disruption across three Indian states. Sources indicate SCADA systems controlling a major pipeline have been compromised by ransomware. Ransomware strain appears to be a variant of BlackCat/ALPHV. Multiple fuel depots reporting inability to receive shipments. This is a Colonial Pipeline-style attack on Indian critical infrastructure.
clean_text: Fuel distribution disrupted across three Indian states. Pipeline SCADA systems compromised by BlackCat/ALPHV ransomware variant. Colonial Pipeline-style attack on Indian infrastructure.
